python3 - <<'PYGATE'
import json,pathlib,subprocess,hashlib
p=pathlib.Path('.kbd-orchestrator/phases/runtime-harness-gap-closure')
s=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['prometheus','kbd','--path','.','status','--json'],text=True))
assert s['phases']['runtime-harness-profile-certification']['status']=='complete'
r=json.loads((p/'evidence/profile-certification-receipt.json').read_text())
assert r['status']=='PASS'

assert r['acceptanceContractSha256']==hashlib.sha256((p/'acceptance-contract.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
required=set(r['requiredRows'])
manifest=p/'evidence/certification-required-rows.json'
assert required==set(json.loads(manifest.read_text())['requiredRows'])
assert r['requirementsSha256']==hashlib.sha256(manifest.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert {'linux/surreal/crash','macos/surreal/crash','linux/postgres/crash','macos/postgres/crash'}<=required
rows={x['id']:x for x in r['rows']}
assert required and required<=rows.keys()
for key in required:
 row=rows[key]
 assert row['status']=='PASS' and row['exitCode']==0 and row['testCount']>0 and row['command']
 assert row['evidence'] and all((p/f).is_file() for f in row['evidence'])
print('Tier 3 milestone receipt gate PASS')
PYGATE
